div.div: 7 انبهر , (S, A, K,) and ↓ ابتهر , (TA,) and ↓ بُهِرَ , like عُنِىَ, (K,) (tropical:) He was, or became, out of breath; his breath became interrupted, by reason of fatigue [or running, or by hard work, or bearing a heavy load; see 1]: (K:) he panted, or breathed [shortly or] uninterruptedly. (S, A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
